quotes.text: Whether it’s Russia’s invasion of Ukraine or the rise of artificial intelligence, we are working together to address some of the most critical challenges facing the world. When we united in defense of our shared democratic values, we are stronger together!

Amidst a growing surge in misinformation online, artificial intelligence continues to pose an evolving threat to election integrity infrastructure. 

My colleagues and I are calling on @CISAgov to inform Congress about the agency’s plan to bolster election security in 2024. https://t.co/ZC44BP6zzB

AI data centers are rapidly expanding across our country in rural areas. These data centers use more energy and water than an entire city, which increases utilities costs for consumers.  

I introduced, along with @RepBlakeMoore, the Unleashing Low-Cost Rural AI Act to require U.S. Departments of Energy, Interior, and Agriculture to study the impact of data centers in order to protect our rural communities.

AI Data Centers are expanding rapidly and using more energy and water than entire cities. That energy demand is driving up utility costs for consumers. [...] My legislation ensures we take a hard look at how this growth impacts rural communities that are powering the AI industry, and make sure families aren’t left paying the price. But at the same time, it’s important that rural communities are not left behind in the new opportunities that AI data centers will provide for agricultural sciences and an improved ability to compete in this modern era.

This week in the House Foreign Affairs Committee, I sounded the alarm on growing national security risks tied to advanced AI chip exports and ongoing U.S. policy surrounding the war in Ukraine. 
 
Watch the full hearing below ⤵️ 
https://t.co/nru0BjAxNS

The future of agriculture is being built right here in the Central Valley.

I was proud to secure $65.1M in 2022 to bring the F3 Initiative to life, helping launch the new F3i Supercomputing Center.  This investment will equip our farmers, researchers, students, and entrepreneurs with cutting-edge AI and supercomputing tools to solve real-world challenges, strengthen our agricultural economy, and keep the Central Valley leading the world in food production.

When we invest in innovation, we invest in the future of the Valley!

This morning, I joined @KMPHFOX26 Great Day Connect to Congress segment to discuss some of the most pressing issues facing our nation—from the rise of AI and the war in Ukraine to SNAP benefits for our families and protecting Yosemite National Park from the Administration’s plan to sell public lands. 

In case you missed it, you can watch down below. ⤵️

https://t.co/Gu4uqU70nn

Who pays the price for the rapid expansion of AI data centers? That’s a question Congress needs to answer.

AI has enormous potential to strengthen our economy, but we cannot ignore the demands it places on our water and energy resources.

I’ve introduced bipartisan legislation to examine these impacts because Valley families should benefit from innovation, not be burdened by its costs.

I think the first and foremost effort is to realize that there are real concerns that Congress needs to address. We need to put some firewalls to protect against the impacts on energy, electricity costs and the use of water, and that’s why I am supporting legislation at the federal level that will slow this process down.
